cases.construction: Two binary units with conditionally independent transitions and no cross-unit causal edges.
cases.claim_ceiling: No consciousness inference; use to test false-positive integration.

cases.construction: Four binary units in a directed feed-forward chain; no feedback edge.
cases.claim_ceiling: Topology/proxy result only unless a formal reference computation passes.

cases.construction: Four binary units in a recurrent directed ring with frozen transition probabilities.
cases.claim_ceiling: No universal ranking expectation across different metrics.

cases.construction: Two recurrent modules with a declared sweep of cross-module coupling from absent to nonzero.
cases.claim_ceiling: Expected direction must be preregistered separately per metric.

cases.construction: Paired models designed to produce similar observational association but different interventional structure.
cases.claim_ceiling: An observational proxy cannot claim causal integration from this case alone.

cases.construction: A connected modular model before and after deletion of a specified bridge edge.
cases.claim_ceiling: Do not assume all measures have the same response to an edge deletion.

cases.construction: The same transition model with unit labels permuted consistently in all states and transition tables.
cases.claim_ceiling: Invariant only for metrics whose specification is label-independent.

cases.construction: The same hypervectors after a common permutation of coordinate indices.
cases.claim_ceiling: Does not test causal IIT unless a causal model is independently supplied.

cases.construction: Compare a base system with a declared duplicated or near-duplicate unit; preserve the original system as a paired case.
cases.claim_ceiling: No assumed universal direction for formal IIT quantities.

cases.construction: Fixed underlying model measured over preregistered noise levels and sample counts.
cases.claim_ceiling: A point estimate without uncertainty is not a calibration result.

cases.construction: Evaluate a subsystem and a declared boundary expansion with a causally independent spectator unit.
cases.claim_ceiling: Do not conceal boundary sensitivity or claim exclusion was searched if it was not.

cases.construction: Compare explicitly constructed micro-step and grouped-step transition models over the same underlying process.
cases.claim_ceiling: Different grains denote different models; raw values are not automatically comparable.

cases.construction: Paired models fit the same observational summaries but differ on at least one intervention.
cases.claim_ceiling: Association-only fit does not validate a causal transition model.

cases.construction: Remove or corrupt a required transition-model field, introduce a non-finite value, or mismatch unit/state dimensions.
cases.claim_ceiling: Invalid inputs must not pass qualification.

cases.construction: Paired held-out cognitive tasks where increased proxy values can be unrelated or adverse to task success.
cases.claim_ceiling: Operational value is a task claim, not a consciousness claim.
